subject: Mittens
name: Mittens and companion — fine lines and light washes

styleSelection.reason: The reference is an airy portrait sketch: connected pale value planes, dry eyes, and fine selective sepia lines. Preserve the fitted shapes and the white vignette.

Mittens.cat-head.reason: Warm tabby planes carry head likeness; fur strands and whiskers are a separate sparse ink layer over dry washes.

Mittens.cat-chest.reason: The white bib is paper, with a connected ochre side plane and only a few directional fur edges.

Mittens.human-face.reason: Very pale warm skin planes, crisp upper lids, softly turning cheek shadows, and almost untouched forehead.

Mittens.human-hair.reason: The broad broken charcoal hair mass is painted progressively in mixed neutral washes; a few curling contours explain locks.

families.referenceCue: Ochre and sienna tabby stripes around upward-looking green-grey eyes; dry upper lids; white muzzle; whiskers curve down and outward. Wash planes first, sparse directional ink after drying.
Large reserved white bib and left shoulder; warm connected shadow down the right flank. Flowing wash body with broken fur edges, never stippled strands.

High-key warm olive skin; almost white forehead and nose ridge; brown irises tucked under tapered dry upper lids; faint mouth and beard planes. Dry shaped mids followed by one connected cheek-to-temple shadow.
Connected neutral charcoal curls, broken by white paper gaps. Pale neutral foundation, dry, broad darker wash and shadow glaze; isolated curling pen accents only at a few outer locks.
